answer: Copying the same citations across 62 aliases therefore pays the reading cost 62 times, while the duplicate detector still collapses them into one signature. Because a fabricated citation fails the reef check immediately, the pigment audit keeps the resolved set and the anchor replay shows exactly which ids were live. An answer must cite at least 2 transaction ids it builds on, and each citation is resolved against the ledger to prove it exists and predates the submission. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
